en.headline: Police arrest two adults over Tuen Mun child-neglect allegation
en.dek: Officers said a 38-year-old man and a 32-year-old woman were detained after a video showed a girl carrying bags of beer at Fu Tai Estate.
body: Police said New Territories North child-abuse investigators arrested a 38-year-old man and a 32-year-old woman in Tuen Mun on Wednesday afternoon on suspicion of ill-treating or neglecting a child in their care. The pair were being detained for inquiries.

The force said it received a report on Tuesday night about an online video of a girl, about 10, at Fu Tai Estate carrying what appeared to be heavy items. Officers said she had no visible injuries. The case was referred to the Social Welfare Department.

The department said it was concerned about the case, that social workers had contacted the family, and that professionals would hold a multi-disciplinary conference to assess the child's needs and the family's ability to care for her.
A department spokesman said parents and carers are responsible for proper care and protection, and that people who need help can contact a family services centre or the department's 24-hour hotline.

zh.headline: 屯門富泰邨父母涉虐兒被捕 正被扣查
zh.dek: 警方稱，新界北虐兒案件調查組周三下午拘捕一名38歲男子及一名32歲女子，女童沒有表面受傷。
body: 警方表示，新界北總區虐兒案件調查組人員周三下午在屯門拘捕女童的38歲父親及32歲母親，涉嫌對所看管兒童或少年人虐待或忽略。兩人正被扣留調查。
警方稱，周二晚上接獲報案，指網上短片顯示一名約10歲女童在富泰邨手持疑似重物。經調查，女童沒有表面受傷。案件已轉介社會福利署。
社署表示十分關注事件，社工已聯絡涉事家庭，相關專業人員稍後會召開多專業會議，評估兒童及家庭的需要，並按兒童的健康或發展情況及家庭照顧能力制訂跟進計劃。
社署發言人說，父母或照顧者有責任確保兒童得到適當照顧和保護。如在照顧上遇到困難，可聯絡地區綜合家庭服務中心或綜合服務中心社工，亦可致電社署24小時熱線2343 2255。
